rappel_detail.anchor: anchor you build on a medium cam or chock
rappel_detail.station: The 20 ft 5.4 step on the Class 3-4 east ridge, reached by reversing the route south of the crest.
rappel_detail.notes: The one rappel that is the norm. Carry a 50-60 m rope so you can also rappel any of the 4th and low-5th ground you climbed.
